subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Role of Recruitment
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Role of Recruitment usable.

hook.text: In a pyramid scheme, the product isn't what's being sold. The real product is recruitment.

buildup.text: Members earn commissions not from sales to customers, but from signing up new members.

discovery.text: When most revenue comes from recruits rather than real customers, it's a pyramid in disguise.

twist.text: Many pyramid schemes wrap themselves in a legitimate product to look like real businesses.

climax.text: The FTC's key test: if income depends on recruiting, not selling, it's likely illegal.

punchline.text: If the pitch is about recruiting, the product is you.

quiz.question: What is the FTC's key test for identifying a pyramid scheme?
options: Whether income depends on recruiting, not selling
